index.title: {{BRAND}} — Vedic Astrology from Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra
index.sub: {{BRAND}} — {{GLOSS}} — is a source-grounded curriculum for Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, from first principles to chart synthesis.
index.desc: A source-grounded Vedic astrology curriculum built on Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra, with a free chart engine that computes Ṣaḍbala, Aṣṭakavarga and sixteen divisional charts in your browser.

grahas.title: The Nine Grahas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
grahas.sub: Full profiles of the Sun through Ketu, the natural benefics and malefics, and the working classifications.
grahas.desc: The nine grahas of Vedic astrology — their natural significations, benefic and malefic character, dignities and karakatvas, as Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra describes them.

dignity.title: Planetary Dignity & Relationships — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
dignity.sub: Exaltation, debilitation, Moolatrikona and own sign; the three tiers of friendship; combustion, war and retrogression; and the nodes.
dignity.desc: Exaltation, debilitation, moolatrikona, own sign and the friendship tables — how a graha's strength is graded by the sign it stands in, with the BPHS rules set out in full.

rashis.title: The Twelve Rashis — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
rashis.sub: Every sign profiled, plus the modality, element, parity, rising-type, fertility and Kalapurusha classifications that drive later technique.
rashis.desc: The twelve rāśis: element, mode, gender, lord, body part and the classical descriptions from Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra, with how each shapes a graha placed in it.

bhavas.title: The Twelve Bhavas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
bhavas.sub: House significations and karakas in depth, functional classes, bhava-lord placements with a worked case, house strength, and how a house prospers or breaks.
bhavas.desc: The twelve bhāvas and what each governs, with the BPHS significations, the bhāva lord's role, and how kendra, trikona, dusthāna and upachaya classify them.

lagna.title: Lagna & Special Ascendants — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
lagna.sub: The rising point that anchors the chart, the twelve ascendant temperaments, and the computed Bhava, Hora, Ghatika, Arudha, Sree and Prana ascendants.
lagna.desc: The lagna — the point of the ecliptic rising in the east — how it is computed, why it moves a degree every four minutes, and why rāśis take unequal times to rise.

vargas.title: Shodasha Vargas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
vargas.sub: All sixteen divisional charts, how to read a varga, and the significance of each of the twelve houses within every chart that is read as a chart.
vargas.desc: The sixteen divisional charts of BPHS — Horā, Drekkāṇa, Navāṃśa, Daśāṃśa and the rest — how each is computed and what each refines in the rāśi chart.

aspects.title: Aspects — Graha & Rashi Drishti — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
aspects.sub: Planetary aspects with the graded glances and Virupa values, sign aspects in full, aspects on houses, and when to use which system.
aspects.desc: Graha dṛṣṭi and rāśi dṛṣṭi: the seventh-house aspect every graha casts, the special aspects of Maṅgala, Guru and Śani, and how the two aspect systems differ.

strength.title: Strength — Shadbala, Bhava Bala & Ishta/Kashta — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
strength.sub: Every Shadbala component and its sub-parts and minimums, house strength, benefic vs difficult potency, and Vimsopaka divisional strength.
strength.desc: Ṣaḍbala in full: sthāna, dig, kāla, cheṣṭā, naisargika and dṛk bala, with Iṣṭa and Kaṣṭa, Viṃśopaka and the required rūpa thresholds, worked step by step.

special-points.title: Arudhas, Argala, Karakas & Karakamsa — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
special-points.sub: Image-points and how to read the Arudha Lagna and Upapada, interventions, both karaka schemes, and the Karakamsa lagna.
special-points.desc: Arudha padas, Upapada, Argala, the Chara Karakas and Karakāṃśa — the special points of BPHS and Jaimini-adjacent technique, with how each is derived.

yogas.title: Yogas — the full catalogue — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
yogas.sub: Yogakaraka, the five Mahapurusha yogas, lunar and solar yogas, the 32 Nabhasa yogas, Raja and Dhana yogas, Parivartana, Vipareeta and Neechabhanga, and the arishta and penury combinations.
yogas.desc: Rāja yogas, Dhana yogas, the Nābhasa yogas and the lunar and solar combinations of BPHS — formation, classical effect, and the cancellation and timing that decide them.

avasthas-longevity.title: Avasthas, Longevity & Maraka — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
avasthas-longevity.sub: The five avastha schemes, and the longevity methods and Maraka doctrine — presented academically, with care.
avasthas-longevity.desc: Bālādi and the other avasthās, with the BPHS longevity and māraka chapters treated as historical doctrine rather than prediction.

dashas.title: Dashas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
dashas.sub: Vimshottari with worked balance-at-birth and sub-period examples, the conditional nakshatra dashas, and the rasi (sign) dashas of BPHS.
dashas.desc: Viṃśottarī daśā from first principles — the nakṣatra lords, the 120-year cycle, balance at birth, and antardaśā arithmetic, with the other BPHS daśā systems.

ashtakavarga.title: Ashtakavarga — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
ashtakavarga.sub: Benefic-point rules, Bhinna- and Sarvashtakavarga with reading thresholds, kakshas, the three shodhanas, and transit interpretation.
ashtakavarga.desc: Aṣṭakavarga worked in full: the bindus each graha contributes, Trikoṇa and Ekādhipatya śodhana, and Sarvāṣṭakavarga with the 337 total that must hold.

now.title: Hindu time now — the pañcāṅga for this moment — {{BRAND}}
now.sub: The five limbs of the day as they stand, for the place you choose — computed in your browser, with no birth chart needed.
now.desc: The current Hindu date and time for any place: tithi, nakṣatra, yoga, karaṇa and vāra with their end-times, the lunar month in both reckonings, sunrise and sunset, and the later-tradition divisions of the day.
